name: io.github.pzalutski-pixel/blenderlens
title: BlenderLens
description: MCP server that lets AI agents build, check, preview and export game assets in Blender

environmentVariables.name: BLENDER_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Blender executable, for background sessions, install-addon, and the check command on a .blend; found on PATH or in the usual install folders when unset

environmentVariables.name: BLENDERLENS_MODE
environmentVariables.description: auto (the Blender window running the add-on if it responds, otherwise a background Blender), live, or background

environmentVariables.name: BLENDERLENS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The address the server connects to for the BlenderLens add-on in live mode

environmentVariables.name: BLENDERLENS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The add-on's port, as set in its preferences

environmentVariables.name: BLENDERLENS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the token the server reads from the add-on's connection file (live-<port>.json)

environmentVariables.name: BLENDERLENS_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for one call; render_preview, run_python, run_script and bake_texture also take a timeout of their own

environmentVariables.name: BLENDERLENS_START_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for a background Blender to come up

environmentVariables.name: BLENDERLENS_RENDER_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where render_preview writes when given no path. When unset, blenderlens/renders in the system temp folder, where previews older than 7 days are removed when the server starts

environmentVariables.name: BLENDERLENS_ALLOW_PYTHON
environmentVariables.description: 0 leaves run_python and run_script out of the tool list and refuses them (not_allowed)

environmentVariables.name: BLENDERLENS_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Folders that every path given to a tool must lie inside, separated by ; on Windows and : elsewhere. render_preview may also write to its render folder (BLENDERLENS_RENDER_DIR). When unset, paths are not confined

environmentVariables.name: BLENDERLENS_RUNTIME_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the add-on writes live-<port>.json for the server, and where recovery copies go; Blender and the server must agree. Default: %LOCALAPPDATA%\blenderlens on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/blenderlens on macOS, and $XDG_STATE_HOME/blenderlens or ~/.local/state/blenderlens elsewhere
